#
# => fake can cat a file to stdout
exec fake -stdout fruits.text
! stderr .
cmp stdout fruits.text

# => fake can cat a file to stderr
exec fake -stderr fruits.text
! stdout .
cmp stderr fruits.text

# => fake asked to cat but no file found
! exec fake -stdout non-existing.text
! stdout .
stderr 'fake: open non-existing.text: no such file or directory'

# => fake cat to stdout and stderr
exec fake -stdout fruits.text -stderr sausages.text
cmp stdout fruits.text
cmp stderr sausages.text

-- fruits.text --
banana
mango
-- sausages.text --
finocchiona
culatello
